description: Source code for the LSM9DS0 gyroscope sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, configuration, data fetching, and conversion functions.

methods.name: lsm9ds0_gyro_power_ctrl
methods.description: Controls power and enable signals for the gyroscope sensor.

methods.name: lsm9ds0_gyro_set_fs_raw
methods.description: Sets the full-scale range of the gyroscope sensor.

methods.name: lsm9ds0_gyro_set_fs
methods.description: Configures the full-scale range based on runtime setting.

methods.name: lsm9ds0_gyro_set_odr_raw
methods.description: Sets the output data rate (ODR) of the gyroscope.

methods.name: lsm9ds0_gyro_set_odr
methods.description: Configures the ODR based on runtime setting.

methods.name: lsm9ds0_gyro_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches a new sample from the gyroscope sensor.

methods.name: lsm9ds0_gyro_convert
methods.description: Converts raw sensor data to sensor_value with proper units.

methods.name: lsm9ds0_gyro_get_channel
methods.description: Retrieves specific axis data from the sensor sample.

methods.name: lsm9ds0_gyro_channel_get
methods.description: Gets the sensor channel data for a specified axis or axes.

methods.name: lsm9ds0_gyro_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes like full scale and sampling frequency.

methods.name: lsm9ds0_gyro_init_chip
methods.description: Initializes the gyroscope chip, including power and configuration.

methods.name: lsm9ds0_gyro_init
methods.description: Initializes the gyroscope device, including checks and setup.
